claude_result_text:
I have improved the cockpit windshield by increasing its size and refining the rake of the side panes. I also enlarged the upper-deck cabin windows on the hump to make them more distinct from one another and from the overall fuselage geometry, addressing the "separate upper-deck windows" requirement. My next step will be to refine the main deck window line for a cleaner silhouette.

Since I have already addressed major parts of the `window_door_lines` requirements (cockpit windshield shape, upper-deck separation), I'll wait for the judge's feedback on these changes before doing further minor tweaks to window size/spacing or doors.

No further edits planned this turn.
